MobileSAM automatic mask generator
==================================

Upstream copyright notice retained by the project:
Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates. All rights reserved.
Upstream license: Apache License 2.0
Upstream source: https://github.com/ChaoningZhang/MobileSAM
Pinned revision: f706ad9c4eb7f219c00d9050e46328518ffb65d2

Local modifications: OpenScaner uses MobileSAM only through automatic mask
generation on CPU, with a bounded input dimension and point batch, then ranks
the generated masks using fixed geometry, border-support, paper-likelihood,
and generator-quality weights before common quadrilateral postprocessing.

The verbatim upstream Apache License 2.0 text is packaged at
licenses/Apache-2.0.txt.
